newsitem.title: USA: United Cos securitizes $600 mln equity loans.
newsitem.headline: United Cos securitizes $600 mln equity loans.

text.p: United Cos Financial Corp, a provider of non-traditional consumer and mortgage loan, said on Tuesday that it priced $600 million of home equity pass-through certificates for public sale to investors.

The company said it expects the certificates will be insured by MBIA Insurance Corp and will receive Triple-A (AAA) investment-grade ratings from Standard & Poor's, Moody's Investor Service, Inc., and Fitch Investors Services, Inc.
UCFC Acceptance Corp is conducting securizations of pass-through certificates, backed primarily by "B/C" quality, first-mortgage, home equity loans originated and/or purchased by United Companies.
